story.text: 규현은 대뜸 나를 인천공항 도착장으로 불러냈다. 이유도 말해주지 않은 채로.
story.reading: gyu-hyeon-eun dae-tteut na-reul in-cheon-gong-hang do-chak-jang-eu-ro bul-leo-naet-da. i-yu-do mal-hae-ju-ji an-eun chae-ro.
story.en: Out of nowhere, Kyuhyun asked me to meet him at Incheon Airport's arrival hall — without telling me why.

story.text: 며칠 전 열쇠고리를 처음 주웠던, 바로 그 자리였다. 그는 주머니에서 뭔가를 꺼내 손바닥 위에 올렸다.
story.reading: myeo-chil jeon yeol-soe-go-ri-reul cheo-eum ju-wot-deon, ba-ro geu ja-ri-eot-da. geu-neun ju-meo-ni-e-seo mwon-ga-reul kkeo-nae son-ba-dak wi-e ol-lyeot-da.
story.en: It was the very same spot where he'd picked up my keychain that first day. He pulled something out of his pocket and set it in his open palm.

story.text: 작은 별 모양 장식이 조명 아래 반짝였다. '이 열쇠고리, 기억나요? 사실 그날 이후로 계속 생각났어요 — 열쇠고리가 아니라, 아가씨가요.'
story.reading: jak-eun byeol mo-yang jang-sik-i jo-myeong a-rae ban-jjag-yeot-da. i yeol-soe-go-ri, gi-eok-na-yo? sa-sil geu-nal i-hu-ro gye-sok saeng-gak-nass-eo-yo — yeol-soe-go-ri-ga a-ni-ra, a-ga-ssi-ga-yo.
story.en: The little star charm glinted under the lights. "Do you remember this keychain? Honestly, ever since that day, I couldn't stop thinking about it — well, not the keychain. You."

story.text: 그는 잠깐 숨을 고르더니, 그 순간을 처음부터 다시 짚어나가기 시작했다.
story.reading: geu-neun jam-kkan sum-eul go-reu-deo-ni, geu sun-gan-eul cheo-eum-bu-teo da-si jip-eo-na-ga-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: He paused to steady his breath, then began retracing that entire moment from the very beginning.

story.text: '바닥에 떨어진 열쇠고리 하나 주운 게 다였는데, 그날 저는 이상하게 아가씨한테서 눈을 뗄 수가 없었어요. 그때부터였던 것 같아요, 제가 자꾸 우연을 만들어서라도 아가씨 앞에 나타나고 싶었던 거.'
story.reading: ba-dak-e tteol-eo-jin yeol-soe-go-ri ha-na ju-un ge da-yeon-neun-de, geu-nal jeo-neun i-sang-ha-ge a-ga-ssi-han-te-seo nun-eul ttel su-ga eop-seot-seo-yo. geu-ttae-bu-teo-yeot-deon geot gat-a-yo, je-ga ja-kku u-yeon-eul man-deul-eo-seo-ra-do a-ga-ssi ap-e na-ta-na-go sip-eot-deon geo.
story.en: "All I did was pick up a keychain that had fallen on the floor, but that day, I strangely couldn't take my eyes off you. I think that's when it started — me wanting to show up in front of you, even if it meant manufacturing coincidences."

story.text: '다들 저를 바람둥이라고 불렀지만, 사실 전 누군가한테 진심을 준 적이 별로 없어요. 무서웠거든요. 근데 아가씨한테는, 자꾸 진심이 새어 나오더라고요.'
story.reading: da-deul jeo-reul ba-ram-dung-i-ra-go bul-leot-ji-man, sa-sil jeon nu-gu-ga-han-te jin-sim-eul jun jeog-i byeol-lo eop-seo-yo. mu-seo-wot-geo-deun-yo. geun-de a-ga-ssi-han-te-neun, ja-kku jin-sim-i sae-eo na-o-deo-ra-go-yo.
story.en: "Everyone called me a player, but honestly, I've rarely given anyone my true heart. It scared me. But around you, it kept slipping out anyway."

story.text: 그는 내 손을 가만히 잡고, 낮고 떨리는 목소리로 말했다. '저 아가씨, 진짜 사랑하는 것 같아요. 그 열쇠고리를 줍던 순간부터, 지금까지 쭉.'
story.reading: geu-neun nae son-eul ga-man-hi jap-go, nat-go tteol-li-neun mok-so-ri-ro mal-haet-da. jeo a-ga-ssi, jin-jja sa-rang-ha-neun geot gat-a-yo. geu yeol-soe-go-ri-reul jup-deon sun-gan-bu-teo, ji-geum-kka-ji jjuk.
story.en: He quietly took my hand and spoke in a low, trembling voice. "Agassi, I think I really love you. From the moment I picked up that keychain, all the way until now."

story.text: 늘 여유롭던 그의 첫 고백은, 그 어떤 능청스러운 농담보다도 서툴고, 그래서 더 진짜 같았다. 나는 그의 손을 마주 잡으며, 조용히 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: neul yeo-yu-rop-deon geu-ui cheot go-baeg-eun, geu eo-tteon neung-cheong-seu-reo-un nong-dam-bo-da-do seo-tul-go, geu-rae-seo deo jin-jja gat-at-da. na-neun geu-ui son-eul ma-ju jap-eu-myeo, jo-yong-hi go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: His first confession — from someone always so composed — was clumsier than any of his usual smooth jokes, and precisely because of that, it felt more real than anything. I held his hand back and quietly nodded.

words.example: 그 순간을 오래 기억할 것 같다.
words.example_reading: geu sun-gan-eul o-rae gi-eok-hal geot gat-da
words.example_en: I think I'll remember that moment for a long time.

words.example: 그는 그 열쇠고리를 아직도 기억하고 있었다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun geu yeol-soe-go-ri-reul a-jik-do gi-eok-ha-go iss-eot-da

words.example_en: His true feelings finally came through.
